name: Deblurring 3D Gaussian Splatting
definition: A deblurring framework that uses differentiable rasterization and 3D Gaussians to render real-time sharp images from blurry inputs, avoiding the high rendering cost of volumetric rendering methods like Deblur-NeRF.
summary: Deblurring 3D Gaussian Splatting reconstructs sharp 3D scenes from blurry inputs using differentiable rasterization for real-time inference, unlike slower volumetric methods.
